narrativeProgression.description: James Morton introduces himself and his candidacy for Vice President English of the Liberal Party of Canada.
He outlines his experience within the Liberal Party, highlighting his roles as Candidate, Deputy Chair of the Council of Presidents, and Writing President.
He emphasizes his understanding of Canada based on his legal practice in Ontario and Newfoundland.
He transitions to speaking in French, acknowledging the need for work while expressing confidence in the Liberal Party's ability to achieve it.
He reiterates his points in English, concluding with a request for support and a thank you.
